title: Float keys beyond the range of a double are equal when their values are equal
notes: Under the Core schema `1e400` and `10e399` both match the float expression and both stand for the value 10^400, so they are one key and the mapping holds a duplicate (section 3.2.1.1: keys are unique; section 3.2.1.3: nodes are equal when their tags and canonical content are equal). YAML 1.2.2 section 10.2.1.4 says a float is an approximation whose range and accuracy depend on the implementation, and section 3.2.1.3 compares scalars by canonical form. A library whose double type overflows to infinity for both keys reaches the same verdict: the case does not depend on which equality is chosen. A library that cannot hold the keys exactly may refuse the document with a `limit` error instead.

provenance.reference: A key identity that treated different spellings of an overflowing float as different keys.
